verses.text: Ix schek Jehová yal juntzanh ley tik winhaj Moisés, ix yalani:

Haton wal jun ley tik sk'anab'ajej junok anima ek'nak lepra t'ay: Ayik snaani to ix b'oxi sk'ool, yowalil syawtej winh sacerdote t'a spatikel campamento chi' yik syilan winh tato manhxa lepra chi' t'ay. Tato syil winh sacerdote chi' to toxo ix el jun yab'il chi', schekan winh ik'chajkot chawanhok nok' much t'a spitzanil, haton nok' wach' icha yalan ley. Skotpax jab'ok te' k'ute', lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Schekan miljokcham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol junok lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.
Slajwi chi' tz'ik'jikot junxo nok' much chi' t'a spitzanil, te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo, slab'chajem t'a skal schiq'uil nok' chamnakxo chi' kalan yet' ha ha'.
Ukel stzikjioch t'a jun mach b'aj ek'nak jun yab'il chi', syalan winh sacerdote chi' to wach'xo jun anima chi'. Haxo nok' much pitzan chi' tz'aktajkanel nok'.

Ha jun mach tz'ilji to wach'xo, yowalil sjuk'el spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a, sjoxanel xil sjolom smasanil, yik wach'xonhej tz'ajkani. Ichato chi' syalxo yoch t'a yol campamento, palta uketo k'ual skan ichnhej ta', maxto yal-laj yoch t'a yol b'aj kajantaxoni.

Haxo t'a yukil k'ual chi', wach' tz'aj sjoxjiel sjolom. Wach' tz'aj sjoxanel xil sti' yet' sk'u sat yet' pax masanil xil ay t'a sniwanil, sjuk'anel spichul, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxikani.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, syik'ankot chawanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' junok nok' kob'es kalnel, jun ab'il sk'inal junjun nok', malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'. Skotpax nanhal yukil libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite, tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet' pax oxeok octavo aceite.
Haxo winh sacerdote chi' schekanoch linhan jun anima yet' yofrenda chi' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi', tz'ik'jikot jun nok' kelem kalnel chi' yet' aceite, sb'akhchajb'at t'a yichanh Jehová silab'il yuj smul jun anima chi'.

Ha b'aj schamtaxon nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj mul yet' nok' silab' stz'a smasanil, hata' smiljicham nok' kelem kalnel chi', yujto a nok' tz'ak'ji yuj mul, yik winh sacerdote tz'ajkan nok', icha nok' tz'ak'ji yuj stupkanel mul, a juntzanh tik yik Jehová yaji.

Slajwi chi' a winh sacerdote chi' tz'ik'ankot jab'ok schiq'uil nok' silab' yuj mul, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach' jun mach sb'oxi sk'ol chi', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Syik'anpaxkot jab'ok aceite winh sacerdote chi', sekanem winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh,
slab'anem jun sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach' t'a skal aceite, stzikem ukelok aceite chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ha aceite tzato kan t'a sk'ab' winh sacerdote chi', sukoch winh t'a jun anima ix b'oxi sk'ool chi', hanheja' t'a sjayil schikin t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' pax t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj ayxo och schiq'uil nok' silab' yuj smul.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite tz'ak'jikank'e t'a sjolom jun anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul t'a yichanh Jehová.

Slajwi chi' syak'anpax nok' silab' winh sacerdote chi', haton nok' silab' yuj yak'ji tup mul. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi'. Slajwi chi', smiljicham nok' kalnel stz'a smasanil silab'il.
Junnhej tz'aj yak'jik'e nok' t'a yib'anh altar yet' ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'a tas swaji. Icha wal chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul jun anima chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, sb'oxikani.

Tato meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix ek' jun yab'il chi', malaj stumin yik syak' nok' silab' sk'anchaj chi', anhej junok nok' kelem kalnel syik'koti yik sb'akhchajoch silab'il t'a yichanh Jehová yuj smul, chab'nhej libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite syak'a' yet' oxeok octavo aceite.
Syik'paxkot chawanhok nok' paramuch yalnhej tas makanhil, hato ha' jantak stzak'wan smanani. Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul, jun nok' snhusjitz'aok.
Ha t'a swajxakil k'ual syik'ankot masanil juntzanh tik jun anima chi' t'a winh sacerdote yik sakb'ikaneli. Ha juntzanh tik tz'ak'jioch t'a yichanh Jehová t'a stielxo skajnub' b'aj sch'ox sb'a.
Slajwi chi' syik'ankot jun nok' kalnel winh sacerdote yet' aceite chi', sb'akhanek' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a silab'il yuj yak'ji tup smul jun anima chi'.

Smilancham nok' kelem kalnel chi' winh, syik'ank'e jab'ok schiq'uil nok' winh, sukanoch winh t'a sjayil schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach'.
Slajwi chi' syak'ank'e jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a yol sk'ab' t'a sk'exanh.
Yet' sb'ab'el yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a swach', stzikanem ukelok aceite ayem t'a yol sk'ab' winh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Syak'paxoch jab'ok aceite chi' winh t'a schikin jun anima chi' t'a swach', t'a smam sk'ab' t'a swach' yet' t'a yiximal smam yok t'a swach', haton b'aj toxo ix och schiq'uil nok' silab' chi'.
Haxo jab'okxo aceite chi' skani, syak'k'e winh sacerdote chi' t'a sjolom jun anima chi', yik stupkanel smul t'a yichanh Jehová.
Slajwi chi', smilancham nok' paramuch chi' winh sacerdote chi' schawanhil.

Ha junok nok' paramuch chi' tz'ak'ji silab'il yuj yak'ji tup mul, haxo junxo nok' snhusjitz'aok yet' pax ixim harina tz'ak'jipax t'a ofrendail. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkan smul jun anima ix b'oxi chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Haton sleyalil tik t'a junok mach ix ek' lepra t'ay, yik tz'alchaji to ix sakb'ixikani tato max tzak'wan yak'an juntzanh silab' icha wal sleyalil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'a winhaj Aarón:
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a lum Canaán, haton lum ol wak' eyikok, talaj swak'b'at junok tas k'ustak yilji tz'el lheb'eb'ok t'a yol he pat ta',
a mach ay yik te' pat chi' yowalil skot t'a junok winh sacerdote syalani: Ay juntzanh k'ustumtak yilji wan yel lheb'eb'ok t'a yol in pat, xchama.

Ayik manto och winh sacerdote t'a yol pat chi', yowalil syal winh to tz'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol te', yik wach' max kan juntzanh k'ael chi' t'a yol pat tato syal winh sacerdote chi' to manh wach'ok yaj jun pat chi'. Slajwi chi' tz'och winh yil tas yilji jun k'ustum tz'el lheb'eb'ok chi'.
Tato ayik syilanoch winh to ha t'a sattak pat chi' ay juntzanh niwak k'ustum lheb'kiltak, yaax yilji, ma chak yilji, yelk'olal to sb'at t'a yol sattak pat chi',
haxo tz'elxita winh t'a yol te' pat chi', syalan winh to smakchajkan te' ukeok k'ual.
Ayik slajwi uke' k'ual chi', sb'atxi winh sacerdote chi' yila'. Tato toxo ix te b'at lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi' t'a sattak pat chi',
yowalil syal winh sacerdote chi' to slipjielta masanil k'een k'een b'aj toxo ix och juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi', b'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Syalanpax winh to sjoschajel masanil sattak yol te' pat chi', haxo masanil spokokal tz'el t'a yool chi', sb'at yumchajkan t'a junok lugar manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Ch'okxo k'een k'een tz'ochpaxkan sk'exulok k'een tz'ik'chajelta chi', ch'okxo lum lum tz'ochpax t'a sattak yol pat chi'.
Tato scheklajxik'e juntzanh k'ustum lheb'kiltak chi' ayik toxo ix ik'jiel k'een k'een chi' yet' toxo ix joschajel sattak pat chi', toxo ix ochpaxkan sk'exul,
sb'at yilanxi winh sacerdote chi'. Tato toxo ix el lheb'eb'ok jun sk'ustumtakil chi', manhxo wach'ok tz'ajkan jun pat chi'.
Yuj chi', a jun pat chi' yowalil spojchajemi. Masanil te te', k'een k'een yet' lum lum ayoch t'a jun pat chi', b'at ak'jikan t'a junok lugar to manh wach'ok t'a stiel chonhab'.
Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a yol jun pat chi' t'a uke' k'ual ayik toxo ix yal winh sacerdote to smakchajkani, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani icha yalan ley, masanto t'a sq'uik'b'ikanemi.
Yalnhej mach swa'i, ma sway t'a jun pat chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul.
Palta tato ayik tz'och winh sacerdote yil jun pat chi', syilan winh to a juntzanh lheb'kiltak chi' max b'eyb'ati yiktax ix b'ojikan yol te' pat chi', syal winh to wach'xo jun pat chi'.
Yik sakb'ixikan te' pat chi', tz'ik'jikot chawanhok nok' much yet' jab'ok te' k'ute' yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' te' hisopo.
Smilancham junok nok' much chi' winh sacerdote t'a yib'anh ha ha' ayem t'a yol jun lum chen, haton ha' skot b'aj sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'.

Slajwi chi' syik'anb'at te' k'ute' chi' winh yet' te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil yet' junxo nok' much pitzanto, slab'anem winh t'a skal ha ha' kalanxo yaj yet' schiq'uil nok' much ix miljicham chi' t'a yol lum chen chi'. Ukel stzikoch winh t'a te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' tz'aj sakb'ixikan jun te' pat chi' yuj schiq'uil nok' much chi' yet' ha ha' sk'eul sjaj, yuj nok' much pitzanto, yuj te' k'ute', yuj te' hisopo yet' lana ch'al k'ik' schakil.
Slajwi chi', tz'aktajkanb'at jun nok' much pitzan chi' t'a stiel chonhab'. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajaj sleyalil t'a junok pat, wach' tz'ajkani, xchi Jehová.

Haton juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a yib'anh lepra smalk'ei, mato t'a yaxk'ail, mato t'a lheb'kiltak saksak yilji, mato t'a juntzanh k'ustumtak t'a pichul yet' t'a spatiktak te' pat. Icha chi' tz'aj snachajel tastak to manh wach'ok yet' tastak to wach'. Haton t'a tik slajwikan cheknab'il t'a juntzanh tik.
